title: 第11章 大黑驴镇第12章 我全要了
slug: 乡村大炮第296章先宣传一波
content_zh:
李大炮立即觉得孟晚晴这个主意不错，不仅仅她的经济被砍断了，他自己同样两袖清风。
目前得到了传承，恢复了正常，当务之急要做的事情就是先脱贫致富。
“媳妇，这主意不错，我去借辆三轮车，把这些黄瓜带到市场去卖。”李大炮说道。
孟晚晴点点头，看着积极上进的李大炮，突然就感觉生活还是有点盼头。
“不对，这个死大炮，刚才喊我什么来着？”
孟晚晴后知后觉，要不是李大炮跑得快，非得揪住他的耳朵好好教训一下。
李大炮只是开个玩笑，今天他没光着上身，而是找了一件洗得发黄变形的t恤穿在身上。
“去王姨家里，王姨家就有一辆脚蹬的三轮车。”
李大炮暗道，随后认准方向，立即向着王姨家里赶去。
王美琴昨晚一觉睡到天亮，今天的她精气神十足，皮肤白里透红，整个人好像年轻了好几岁，姿色也更上一层楼。
“以前的日子都算是白活了。”
王美琴开口感叹，心中正想着李大炮这个小冤家，随后就看到了他。
“王姨！”
李大炮喊道，他一眼就看到了院子里的三轮车，都生锈了，也不知道还能不能骑。
“大炮，有事吗？”
王美琴忽然有种双腿发软的感觉，不会又要来换灯泡吧，大白天的可不太合适。
“王姨，我想借你家的三轮车骑一下。”李大炮说道。
“你骑三轮车干什么？”王美琴疑惑的问道。
“我去赶个集，卖点东西。”李大炮回道。
“你去赶集？到时候可别迷路，回不来。”王美琴立即一脸担心。

“不会的，新来的村支书跟我一起去。”李大炮回道。
“这样啊，那好吧，对了，村支书在家里有没有欺负你，比如让你脱衣服什么的？”
王美琴立即问道，似乎担心被孟晚晴吃干抹净，到时候她连口汤都喝不到。
李大炮一阵汗颜，连忙回道：“没有没有，我们一人睡一个屋。”
“那就好，我看看车子还有没有气，没气得打点气，最好给链条再刷点机油。”王美琴说道。
李大炮都懂，这些他也都会做，不用王美琴操心。
看着他推着三轮车离去，王美琴一阵心痒痒，要不是担心隔墙有耳，只怕大早上的，也想让李大炮回屋去换个灯泡。
李大炮来到外面，就被一群村妇给围住了。
“大炮，一大早的从王姨里出来，你王姨是不是给你什么好吃的了？”
“或者什么好玩的，需要你们两个人一起玩的游戏？”
“王姨是不是交代你不能说，没关系的，你大胆说，我们会为你保密的。”
一群村妇也没有个正经，大家都相互猜忌，都觉得其她人已经占了李大炮的便宜。
“没有啊，我们什么都没有玩，也没有吃。”
“赵婶，下次我还要跟你玩过家家的游戏。”
“周婶，下次能不能别喊我死鬼。”
……
李大炮一脸憨憨的说道，这些村妇平常没事也会吃他豆腐，占他便宜，因此有不少把柄落在他的手上。
此刻他就这么毫无顾忌的说了出来，可把一群村妇臊的不行。
“大炮，你瞎说什么呢？”
“你个死大炮，等下我男人回来了，可不得揍死你。”

“你们都看着我干什么，我真没喊过大炮死鬼，他一个傻子说的话不能信。”
content_en:
Li Dapao immediately felt that Meng Wanqing's idea was a good one. Not only was her finances cut off, but he himself also had nothing to lose.
Now that it has been inherited and returned to normal, the most urgent thing to do is to get rid of poverty and become rich first.
"Daughter-in-law, this is a good idea. I'll borrow a tricycle and take these cucumbers to the market to sell." Li Dapao said.
Meng Wanqing nodded, looking at the motivated Li Dapao, and suddenly felt that there was still some hope in life.
"No, this damn cannon, what did you call me just now?"
Meng Wanqing later realized that if Li Dapao hadn't run so fast, she would have grabbed his ears and taught him a lesson.
Li Dapao was just joking. Today he was not shirtless. Instead, he found a T-shirt that had been washed yellow and deformed to wear.
"Go to Aunt Wang's house. Aunt Wang's house has a pedal tricycle."
Li Dapao secretly thought, then he found the direction and immediately rushed towards Aunt Wang's house.
Wang Meiqin slept until dawn last night. Today she is full of energy, her skin is fair and rosy, she seems to be several years younger, and her appearance is even better.
"My previous days were all in vain."
Wang Meiqin sighed, thinking about her little enemy Li Dapao, and then she saw him.
"Aunt Wang!"
Li Dapao shouted. He saw the tricycles in the yard at a glance. They were all rusty and he didn't know if they could still be ridden.
"Cannon, is something wrong?"
Wang Meiqin suddenly felt that her legs were weak. She had to change the light bulb again. It was not suitable in broad daylight.
"Aunt Wang, I want to borrow your tricycle for a ride." Li Dapao said.
"Why are you riding a tricycle?" Wang Meiqin asked doubtfully.
"I'm going to a market to sell some things." Li Dapao replied.
"Are you going to the market? Don't get lost and you won't be able to come back." Wang Meiqin immediately looked worried.
"No, the new village party secretary will come with me." Li Dapao replied.
"That's it, okay then, by the way, has the village party secretary ever bullied you at home, such as asking you to take off your clothes or something?"
Wang Meiqin asked immediately, as if she was worried that Meng Wanqing would eat her up and she wouldn't even be able to drink the soup.
Li Dapao felt ashamed and quickly replied: "No, no, we will sleep in a room each."
"That's good. Let me see if the car still has air. If it doesn't, give it some air. It's best to brush some more engine oil on the chain." Wang Meiqin said.
Li Dapao knows everything, and he can do all these things, so Wang Meiqin doesn't have to worry about it.
Watching him push the tricycle away, Wang Meiqin felt itchy in her heart. If she hadn't been worried that the partition wall had ears, she would have wanted Li Dapao to go back to the house to change a light bulb in the morning.
When Li Dapao came outside, he was surrounded by a group of village women.
"Cannon, you came out of Aunt Wang's house early in the morning. Did your Aunt Wang give you something delicious?"
"Or something fun, a game that requires the two of you to play together?"
"Did Aunt Wang tell you not to tell? It doesn't matter. Just say it boldly and we will keep it a secret for you."
A group of village women are not serious either. They are all suspicious of each other and feel that others have taken advantage of Li Dapao.
"No, we didn't play anything or eat."
"Aunt Zhao, I will play house with you next time."
"Aunt Zhou, can you please don't call me a dead ghost next time."
…
Li Dapao said with a naive expression that these village women would eat him and take advantage of him, so he had a lot of tricks in his hands.
At this moment, he said it without any scruples, which made a group of village women feel ashamed.
"Cannon, what are you talking about?"
"You damn cannon, I won't beat you to death when my man comes back."
"What are you all looking at me doing? I never called him a damn cannon. I can't believe what a fool said."
